name: Garrett County, Maryland (United States)
description: White field charged with the elliptical county emblem: a large snowflake for winter, water with a sailboat, and oaks and conifers for the mountains, divided by green, with GARRETT COUNTY, 1872 and MARYLAND around it in blue.
history: Garrett County is the westernmost county of Maryland, completely within the Appalachian Mountains. The flag was adopted in 1988 (prescribed by chapter 21 of the county code, enacted in 1988 (ch. 211), according to Flags of the World; the same source explains the snowflake as winter, the water as sailing and the oaks and conifer as the county's mountains).

features.role: elliptical county emblem in blue, green and light blue with a snowflake, water and trees
